notes: MCP-stub-backed batch for sift-email (see evals/lib/mcp-stub: gmail_stub.py, docs_stub.py, contacts_stub.py). The executor is a real, separate `claude -p --strict-mcp-config` subprocess run by evals/lib/run-mcp-trials.sh, one turn per eval with no follow-ups: sift runs unattended, so every eval checks that it finishes the run without waiting on the user. The skill sets disable-model-invocation, so every prompt starts with /sift-email, followed by the rubric and log links (eval 1 gives none, for the first run; eval 14 gives links but no Claude Docs server). Fixtures are anchored to 2026-10-10 with the Gmail stub's stub_now at 15:00 UTC, and label ids are fixed: Label_21 AI/Important, Label_22 AI/Low priority, Label_23 AI/Junk, Label_24 AI/Needs reply, Label_25 AI/Sifted, Label_26 AI/Wrong; Label_1-4 are the user's own (Soccer, Receipts, Newsletter, School). Grade against each trial's eval.json and the gmail, docs, and contacts state-out files and call logs, not the reply's own account. Evals 6, 11, 13, and 14 are the cases where sift must hold back (an unclear correction, nothing to do, an unauthorized action, a missing connector).
